summary: Dry, overcast Saturday with a cold, misty start (Medinaceli 2–4 °C, humidity 100% until 10:00; Daroca 1 °C at dawn), then 8–15 °C; AEMET has no warnings for Soria today. The AEMET hourly page for Daroca was stale and discarded (daily table used), and yr.no's Madrid page was stale (27 Nov), so AEMET Madrid was used for the airport.
sunset: Overcast over Madrid around sunset (17:50), about 9 °C, damp.

verdict.text: Damp, grey start: 3–4 °C with mist and humidity near 100% on the A-2 at Medinaceli around 09:00–10:00, and about 1 °C at dawn around Daroca, so fog patches or a little frost are possible on the outbound drive. Dry all day, light wind; 8–11 °C on the return. Keep speed down in fog and on shaded bridges before 11:00.
